## About
Auto Chek Centers is a test-only smog check station on Sepulveda Blvd in Manhattan Beach, serving drivers across Los Angeles and Orange County. Test-only means our job is simple: give your vehicle an honest, unbiased test.
We can test and certify most vehicles, including gross polluters, hybrids, motorhomes and diesel vehicles. If your car doesn't pass, we show you where it fell short, including any trouble codes from your on-board computer.
We are also a registration service, so we can handle most California renewals and title transfers and issue tags onsite. We are not a branch of the DMV, so not every DMV transaction can be done here, but many can.

## Services
- Smog test, 2000 and newer: Test-only smog test or pre-inspection for 2000 and newer vehicles. ($59.95)
- Smog test, 1996 thru 1999: Test-only smog test or pre-inspection for 1996 through 1999 vehicles. ($69.95)
- Smog test, 1976 thru 1995: Test-only smog test or pre-inspection for 1976 through 1995 vehicles. ($79.95)
- Registration renewal: Most California renewals processed onsite, with renewal tags issued here. ($24.95)
- Title transfer and duplicate title: California title transfers and duplicate title requests. ($44.95)
- Replacement credentials: Replacement registration cards, stickers and license plates. ($24.95)
- Notary service: Notary services available. ($15 per signature)

## FAQ
Q: What happens if my car fails?
A: You get one free retest, valid for 30 days from the date of the failed inspection.

Q: Are you the DMV?
A: No. We are a vehicle registration service, not a branch of the DMV, so not every DMV transaction can be completed here.

Q: Which vehicles do you test?
A: We test vehicles 1976 and newer.

Q: Can I pay for registration services by check?
A: No. Registration services are debit, credit card and cash only.

Q: Do I have to pass smog to avoid registration penalties?
A: No, you don't. Ask the cashier and they can explain how it works.
